Cross-platform Flutter mobile applications (HR Direct, Fintech, Accounts, Payroll), custom UPI payment gateways (IppoPay seller payouts and API architecture), and real-time event-driven microservices with Apache Kafka and RabbitMQ.

- Full Stack Developer — Nexware Technologies Pvt Ltd (April 2019 – July 2019; Coimbatore, India). Angular, CodeIgniter, and Laravel eCommerce platforms.
- Full Stack Developer — Techmyntra (June 2016 – March 2019; Tirupur, India). PHP, Laravel, GST billing software, bulk SMS messaging infrastructure, and payment gateway solutions.

## AI Enthusiast: Automation Solutions & Tooling
Kalaiselvan Thiyagarajan is an active AI enthusiast continuously learning, experimenting with, and implementing modern AI automation solutions:
- Custom Agents Development: Exploring multi-agent orchestration, tool-calling execution loops, and automated software delivery tasks.
- Model Context Protocol (MCP): Building and integrating MCP servers to securely connect LLMs and coding assistants with internal APIs, databases, and local systems.
- Developer Productivity Copilots: Harnessing GitHub Copilot, Google Antigravity developer tools, and structured prompt engineering for faster delivery and automated verification.
- Vector Retrieval & Document OCR: Experimenting with local vector search layers (such as Alibaba's open-source zvec ecosystem) and vision-language document processing (such as Baidu's Unlimited-OCR) for intelligent data extraction.
